tasks.title: Front Door service, human confirmation and offline CLI fixture (release stage 1)
definition_of_done: The Front Door service runs the CLINICAL_WORKFLOW end-to-end flow: encounter, snapshot at a decision time, deterministic safety screen, gateway call, recommendation held pending human review
A recommendation cannot take effect without a recorded human confirmation; the original output is preserved immutably when a reviewer overrides it
A synthetic CLI fixture runs the whole flow offline with no network, satisfying Innovation release stage 1
Re-assessment at a later decision time preserves the earlier output rather than replacing it
evidence: innovation/frontdoor/service.py runs the CLINICAL_WORKFLOW flow: snapshot at a decision time, gateway call, recommendation held pending human review.
Human confirmation is structural, not advisory: act_on() raises HumanReviewRequired until a reviewer confirms, and only CONFIRM or MODIFY make a recommendation effective — REJECT and ESCALATE do not.
Overrides preserve the original output immutably; the review is recorded alongside it and mirrored into the audit record with overridden_from.
Re-assessment at a later decision time appends to history rather than replacing the earlier recommendation; snapshot checksums differ.
Label-modality evidence is excluded from live decisions even once its available_at_time has passed — an outcome is not a feature.
Offline CLI fixture: `python3 -m innovation.demo` runs the full flow with no network (Innovation release stage 1).
13 tests in tests/test_frontdoor.py, passing.

tasks.title: Front Door HTTP API (FastAPI)
definition_of_done: Every Front Door capability is reachable over HTTP; the UI is one caller of the same API and has no privileged path
A client speaking only to the API cannot reach a state the safety spec forbids
Non-synthetic journeys are refused
evidence: innovation/api/app.py exposes health, journey registration, assessment, recommendation read, human review, history, an effective-gate endpoint, and audit read.
The API adds no clinical logic: it parses, delegates and serialises, so no second copy of the safety behaviour exists at the edge.
GET /recommendations/{id}/effective returns 409 until a human confirms, and 200 with the confirming reviewer afterwards. Rejecting keeps it at 409.
PUT /journeys refuses any journey whose data_classification is not SYNTHETIC (403) — the prototype has no approval path for real data (DEC-0006).
A review action outside the contract, and an anonymous reviewer, are both refused by the schema at 422 before any handler runs.
Every recommendation payload carries the RESEARCH PROTOTYPE - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED banner and its effective flag, so a client cannot render one without them.
13 tests in tests/test_api.py, passing.
